title: Research Index
introduction: One entry for each published research project. The index connects the states shown in the Register with the concepts, protocols, archives and occurrences that constitute them.

entries.title: Temporal Signatures
entries.summary: A date and time inscribed at the moment of closure become a form, an identifier, an index and an entry point into an archive.

evidence.label: Interpretation
evidence.text: Their reading as form, index and closure belongs to the current conceptual formulation.

entries.title: The Summons of the Milieu
entries.summary: A situated signal summons an action. The research observes the gap between the flow, the response and the archive that attempts to retain it.

evidence.label: Hypothesis
evidence.text: The relationship between signal, action and archive remains to be tested.

evidence.label: Unknown
evidence.text: No proven signal or completed occurrence is documented to date.

entries.title: Studies of the Ordinary
entries.summary: A real everyday action becomes a recorded performance, then the material for a conversation, a question, a Poème de l’après-coup and a possible HTML form.

evidence.label: Documented fact
evidence.text: Three studies exist in the private archive.

evidence.label: Public state
evidence.text: The introduction is published. Recordings, poems and conversations remain private.

principle.title: The index grows with the research.
principle.text: A project may receive new versions, directions or occurrences without being presented as complete. Numbers organise the entries, they do not rank their importance.
